name: Missing Pen Up
hint: You use the [sbi]pen down[/sbi] block but you never lift the pen again, so your sprite will draw forever.
instruction: You use the [sbi]pen down[/sbi] block but you never lift the pen again, so your sprite will draw forever.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
erase all
pen down//⇦  🐛
repeat (10)
glide (1) secs to [random position v]
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
when green flag clicked
erase all
pen down
repeat (10)
glide (1) secs to [random position v]
end
pen up //⇦  👍
